verdict.rationale: Asana is a work-management and project-tracking SaaS. It does not author, host or sign git commits, so requiring signed AI-authored commits is a category error for this product type. Its GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket integrations only sync issue and pull-request status into tasks. Its AI Teammates act on tasks, not code commits, so the commit-signing axis never becomes applicable.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can require AI-authored commits to be cryptographically signed with my SSH or GPG key
